title: Curate cross-system jurisdiction and coverage reference cases
method: Each case cites an official HTTPS page retrieved on the evaluation date. A quotation is copied only from that response after HTML tags are removed and whitespace is collapsed. Coverage labels record what the citation and the pinned disposition snapshot do not establish. They are not holdings about a person, act, or dispute.

known_limitations: No case records a legal conclusion. expected.legal_conclusion is not_claimed, and overlapping or special authority keeps applicability not_claimed.
source.license is unknown on every case. Organization membership and a public website are not treated as a redistribution grant.
source.revision is null. Response SHA-256 values identify the retrieved bytes, including page chrome, and are not the publisher's revision id.
The Netherlands municipal collection is included in the snapshot. The Dutch criminal-code case does not say that collection lacks a gemeente.
The German consolidation is explicitly non-official on the publisher's own Hinweise page.
The Belgian German-language request did not verify a German text.
The Egyptian cover was read with pdftotext. Bidirectional extraction is not a diplomatic transcription, so the fixture quotation is null. PDF metadata names Microsoft Word 2016 as Creator.
Disposition rows were counted by family. Their law text was not opened.
